rules: Never infer rejection from omitted checkbox. Never interpret event-sharing as approval of a different work or a different ritual act.
Never auto-publish a candidate because it has a matching subject: official source identity, native photo, frame-free composition and licensing are separate gates.
No new boxes, prominent provenance panels or pill controls. Runtime metadata is non-visual.
Strict zero cost; do not buy photos, subscribe to APIs or contact owners.
